text: Claro is the brand of America Movil's Mexican operator Telcel; America Movil is listed (BMV: AMXB; NYSE: AMX) and controlled by the Slim family. Formerly state-owned Telmex, privatised in 1990 - since then no state shareholding.
short: Claro is the brand of America Movil's Mexican operator Telcel; America Movil is listed (BMV: AMXB; NYSE: AMX) and controlled by the Slim family.
